title: Process to apply for Fresh / Reissue Ordinary Passport
text: To start an ordinary passport application, register or sign in on the Passport Seva portal. Open Services and choose Apply for Fresh Passport/Re-issue of Passport. Select the appropriate application type, fill in the requested details, review them and submit.

title: Process to apply for Fresh / Reissue Ordinary Passport
text: The portal generates an Application Reference Number (ARN) when the completed application is submitted. A partially filled application can be saved and resumed before submission.

title: Apply For Re-Issue of Ordinary Passport
text: For an ordinary passport, the portal distinguishes Fresh and Reissue by whether the applicant has previously held an ordinary passport. Someone who previously held an ordinary passport should select Reissue when applying for an ordinary passport again.

title: Process to apply for Fresh / Reissue Ordinary Passport
text: After submitting the application, open the submitted application and use Pay and Schedule Appointment. Select the preferred Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK), review the available slot and complete payment. The portal displays appointment confirmation after payment succeeds.

title: Process to apply for Fresh / Reissue Ordinary Passport
text: If the fee has already been paid or an appointment already exists, the application guide points to Schedule/Reschedule Appointment in the portal. For an existing appointment, open the relevant application to look for the rescheduling option.

title: New Process for Online Appointment Booking
text: The walkthrough shows opening the submitted application and choosing Reschedule Appointment. It displays the remaining attempts during confirmation. Select the preferred PSK, review the available date and confirm the new booking. The walkthrough indicates that a successfully booked replacement cancels the earlier appointment for that ARN.

title: Passport Seva Fee Payment FAQ
section: Online Payment — payment made but no appointment
text: If payment succeeded but there is no booking, the FAQ directs the applicant to Schedule Appointment. The portal also provides Track Payment Status to check the payment.

title: Passport Seva Application Form FAQ
section: Documents to be attached with the application form
text: Passport Seva says to present the original supporting documents for verification and submit self-attested photocopies at the appointment. Which supporting documents are required depends on the applicant scenario.

title: Document Required for Fresh Passport
text: For fresh application document guidance, open the Fresh Passport Document Advisor and select the applicable application type and applicant category. For the supported scenario, start with Normal and Adult and follow the official options shown.

title: Document Required for Re-issue of Passport
text: For reissue document guidance, open the Reissue Document Advisor. It asks for case details including applicant category, employment type, whether the address changed and Non-ECR status. Use the official result for the actual combination.

title: Document Required for Re-issue of Passport — select applicable cases
text: The reissue case selector distinguishes a passport approaching expiry from a passport that has already expired. Select the reason matching the situation to continue through the advisor.
